tripadvisor.licence: CC0 according to publisher; retained from accepted proposal
tripadvisor.selection: 5,261 Lisbon establishments (country = Portugal AND city = Lisbon); initial 8 source_ids pinned to establishment_id 1..8 for deterministic ordering
tripadvisor.caveat: cuisines mixes cuisine and venue-type labels; no exclusive category inferred

culture.input: Approved proposal XML, unchanged copy; municipal ArcGIS origins retained inside XML

synthetic_rules.method: Manually specified deterministic fixtures in data/synthetic_activity.json
synthetic_rules.persons: All fictional; composite natural candidate key (display_name, contact_phone); same display_name or shared phone alone does not imply same person
synthetic_rules.reservations: All simulated, including fulfilled (12), cancelled (2), no_show (2) and future confirmed (3); composite natural candidate key (person_id, establishment_id, scheduled_at)
synthetic_rules.visits: All simulated; includes fulfilled reservation attendances (12), walk-ins (9) and cultural visits (7); composite natural candidate key (person_id, visited_at)
synthetic_rules.party_size: Includes the named person and unnamed companions; not unique visitor count
synthetic_rules.time_zone: Europe/Lisbon; explicit offsets in fixtures; September is UTC+01
